name: @finchtoys/mcp-client
description: Connect Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into Finch.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=bundle --external:finch --banner:js="import { createRequire as __finchCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __finchCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js

finch.name: MCP Client
finch.description: Connect to Model Context Protocol servers, expose their tools to the Finch, and provide an mcp.client capability for other extensions.
finch.systemPrompt: Use MCP with action=list/add/edit/remove/connect/disconnect to manage configured MCP services. For an OAuth-enabled HTTP MCP service, action=connect runs OAuth discovery, Dynamic Client Registration, and PKCE; do not check status first when the user asks to authorize. Never ask users to paste secrets in chat, because add/edit opens a secure form for secret values. To add an HTTP (url) MCP server just pass name+url — the form shows one API-token field and auto-creates a standard 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header; never pass, view, or hand-edit the token or any header, and only set authHeader for a non-standard header name (e.g. X-Api-Key). To use actual MCP server tools, when the target server name is known first call Finch ToolSearch with source:"mcp:<server>"; fall back to source:"mcp" only if that precise search finds no usable tool, because mcp__<server>__<tool> names are never pre-loaded and will fail if called directly. ToolSearch connects the selected servers, discovers their tools, and injects mcp__<server>__<tool> functions into the current run. Authorization can be granted per-tool (mcp__filesystem__read_file) or with a wildcard (mcp__filesystem__*).

promptGuides.title: Connect a filesystem MCP server
promptGuides.description: Ask Finch to help create a local servers.json config for filesystem access.
promptGuides.prompt: Help me configure MCP Client with a filesystem MCP server for my current project directory.
